summary: Multi-Station Broadcast Center end-to-end verification (backend + frontend). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass covering stations CRUD (upsert/list/get/update/delete + missing-id/404 cases) and per-station now-playing isolation. Frontend Playwright: license seeded, install prompt dismissed, Go Live opens stations-modal with default 'Hot Live 95' card + global bar (broadcast-golive-all/stop-all/meta-format/level). Add station, edit fields, backend upsert confirmed. Test connection returns graceful 'Couldn't reach fake.example.com:8000' banner. Station Go Live transitions status to ' Error' gracefully (no React crash), app-root and modal remain mounted. Simulcast on default station gated (disabled) because default has no host/password — click on new+default did not crash. QR canvas and embed code toggle correctly. /live?station=<new_id> renders listen-live-page with live-station-name='TEST_Alpha' (branding applied). /live (default) shows 'HOT LIVE 95'. Delete removes card + backend doc.

issues: Default 'Hot Live 95' station is only synced to backend when user opens/edits it. /live?station=<default_id> before any edit would 404 on branding fetch (page still falls back to defaults, but station-specific branding won't apply). Consider auto-upserting on first load or on modal open.

action_items: (Optional) On App mount or first Broadcast Center open, upsert existing localStorage stations to backend so /api/stations/<default_id> returns branding even before user edits.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stations endpoints are minimal and correct; _station_public strips _id via explicit field allowlist — good.
DELETE /api/stations/{id} also clears nowplaying doc keyed by same id — good side-effect for cleanup.
Frontend StationsModal.js: StationCard useState edit default `!station.host && !station.streamUrl` — new stations auto-expand, existing configured stations auto-collapse. Behaves as expected.
Simulcast Go Live button is disabled when host/password missing (guards against noise), which prevented triggering fan-out on the untouched default station in tests — expected behavior.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-station Broadcast Center is fully functional. Install prompt (data-testid=install-prompt) intercepts the first click on go-live-button — dismiss via 'Maybe later' or set localStorage.hotlive95_install_dismissed='1' before load. Default station requires user-edit to reach backend; /live?station=<id> only branded after upsert.
